Welcome to O Projeto Riza.
We are an animal sanctuary in Portugal.
Here, rescued farmed animals find safety, care, and freedom – and we share their stories with the world.

On this channel, you’ll find:
🐐 Life at the sanctuary – daily care, challenges, and joys
🐄 Stories of the animals and their journeys
🌱 Our transition from O Projeto Riza to a new land
🤝 Ways you can be part of this change

Join us at O Projeto Riza: a place of healing, freedom, and connection for humans and non-human animals alike.
